        When changing a species name, update the Chemkin thermo NASA

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```java
name = spe.getThermoData().getName();
spe.setName(spe.getThermoData().getName());
```
Reason:
The bug occurs because when a species is renamed using its name from the primary thermo library, the Chemkin file does not get updated with the new name. The old name is retained in the thermo section, leading to inconsistencies in the thermo data referenced in the Chemkin file.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```java
spe.generateNASAThermoData();
```
Reason:
This statement regenerates the Chemkin-formatted NASA polynomials after the species name has been updated. By doing so, it ensures that the thermo section in the Chemkin file reflects the new species name, thus resolving the inconsistency and ensuring that the correct thermo data is referenced.
